[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Vegan Chili: Black beans, sweet potatoes, and spices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Gluten-Free Chili: Gluten-free beer and chili powder.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Low-Carb Chili: Ground turkey, veggies, and no beans.  
[PREFERENCE] User prefers the Traditional Beef Chili recipe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a slow cooker recipe for Traditional Beef Chili with the following ingredients:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 lb ground beef  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 large onion, diced  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 3 cloves of garlic, minced  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 red bell pepper, diced  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 2 tbsp chili powder  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 tsp ground cumin  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 tsp dried oregano  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - 1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
